create_rnn_encoder: create an RnnEncoder with a specified vocab size, embedding dimension, and hidden state size
build_gru_encoder: build an RnnEncoder using a GRU cell type with multiple stacked layers
build_lstm_encoder: build an RnnEncoder using an LSTM cell type for sequence encoding
encode_sequence: encode a batch of token sequences into hidden state vectors using the RnnEncoder forward pass
encode_sequence_with_lengths: encode a batch of padded sequences by providing explicit length tensors to the forward pass
